name: Cyber Clash
summary:
Cyber Clash is a GTag movement game that merges singleplayer and multiplayer elements. The main story will be told through special missions that include elements from different multiplayer modes, but contain no PvP elements. Missions can be completed both by yourself and with friends in co-op.

The multiplayer will be based around competitive modes and guild competitions. Guilds are formed through the game's Discord and reflected in-game.
